_comment: Tamework shared access, Part 2 (Runeteria), driven by hand (no rig test file yet). Tamework's HEAD, Rune_Husbandry's tamed livestock, the Rune_Professions branch feat/tamework-shared-access (the runeteria:guild group, Husbandry XP to the acting player, RuneCore's database as Tamework's network settings store), RuneCore and RuneGuild. On 2026-11-11 the ref form of Rune_Professions failed in env.py's temp worktree: its ITEM ENUM content gate needs Rune_AssetPack beside the repo (exit 2, 'Rune_AssetPack not found - CANNOT VERIFY'). The run used a jar built in the branch worktree with `gradlew build` and RUNE_ASSET_PACK pointing at Runeteria/Rune_AssetPacks/Rune_AssetPack, added by path in place of the ref. RuneClaims and RuneEconomy are here only so a guild can be founded (RuneGuild's starter land comes from RuneClaims; founding costs money); `/guild admin forceadd` works from a player, not from the console. Bots are started by hand, not here (env.py's memory estimate).
